---
type: parens
title: 'Make it equal $0$ when $x = 2$'
expression: − 1 · x · − 1 + x + 2 − 2 − 1
target: "0"
x: 2
---

Tap a gap to place **(**, then a gap to its right to place **)**. Put **one** pair of parentheses in the expression so that it equals $0$ when $x = 2$.

## Hint
Without parentheses it equals $2x - 1$, which is $3$ when $x = 2$. Parentheses make a group get worked out **before** the multiplications around it. Try a few gaps and read the feedback.

## Hint
A product is $0$ when one of its factors is $0$. Can you make a group after $-1 \cdot x \cdot$ that equals $0$ when $x = 2$?

## Solution
**Answer:** $-1 \cdot x \cdot (-1 + x + 2 - 2 - 1)$

The group in parentheses is worked out first:
$$
\begin{aligned}
    -1 + x + 2 - 2 - 1 &= x - 2 \\
    \text{so}\quad -1 \cdot x \cdot (x - 2) &= -1 \cdot 2 \cdot (2 - 2) \quad \text{when } x = 2 \\
                                           &= -2 \cdot 0 = 0
\end{aligned}
$$

No single pair of parentheses makes the expression equal $0$ for **every** $x$, which is why this puzzle fixes $x = 2$.
